name: Brand Bar
tagline: html-animation's type-led brand clip: bone ground, tight bold sans, an accent bar that travels.

motion.direction: Type-led brand clip. One entrance language for the whole piece: lines pop in (scale 0.4 → 1.08 → 1), exit by scaling down. Mixed case, weight 700, 2–4 words per line that fill the measure; the key word of each statement marked with a `strikeLine` used as an underline bar (strikeAt 0.15, strikeDur 0.3, `ter`). A slow push runs under every hold — nothing is ever still, so beats are 2.3–2.7 s and similar beats have equal lengths. Counters for numbers. Straight image cards. No stamps, no patterns, no tilted cards, no photos bleeding the frame, no chips stacks.
